notes.title: Steam Summer Sale
notes.content:
Hello CrateTastrophers!

The Steam Summer Sale has begun! 

From now till July 8th CrateTastrophe will be on sale with a 10% discount!

notes.title: CrateTastrophe is going global!
notes.content:
Hello again CrateTastrophers!

Our little game is going global, with players from Russia, China, the United States, Germany, Finland, Brazil, Argentina and many many more!

I hope you are all having great fun and gun ! 

Keep playing and let your friends know the game is now greatly discounted!

notes.title: For a limited time ONLY - CrateTastrophe at 70% off!!!
notes.content:
For a limited time, and to celebrate our first month and first major patch out, CrateTastrophe is going on sale!

Share the news and remember that we have a tournament running - be the first to reach 3000 points and win the right to name the 3000 points achievement!

What are you waiting for? go smash some crates!

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is now live!
notes.content:
Hello CrateTastrophers!

We are happy to release the first major patch for the game which includes:

[list]
[*] Challenge mode - fixed several bugs, added additional buttons to have a more seamless quit and return to start menu options
[*] Store - added graphical assets to clarify currency, fixed achievement related bugs and other inconsistencies
[*] General - bug fixes, repaired some assets
[/list]

With this patch the game runs better and smoother.

We are not done with this update! The next major patch will include new mechanics and brand new game options, so stay tuned.

Have fun everyone and we'll see you in the game!

notes.title: First patch coming this weekend!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The first major update for CrateTastrophe will go live this weekend!

Here is what to expect:

[list]
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Quality of life improvements (especially the in-game store)
[*] Various improvements
[/list]

Exciting times are coming! 

See you all soon!

notes.title: News Update!
notes.content:
Hello again CrateTastrophers!

First we want to thank you all for the interest, the direct feedback and comments and of course for playing the game and the demo!

We have some news items to share:
[list]
[*] Had to our [url=https://www.starstrikestudios.com/]website[/url] for a major announcement on a future development for CrateTastrophe
[*] We have had some good [url=https://gameskeys.net/top-steam-games-to-tryout-in-april-2021/]reviews and mentions[/url] recently, check them out!
[*] We want to remind everyone that the tournament is still going strong! Get in for a chance to win a very cool prize
[/list]

That's it for now, keep shooting at those crates and we'll see you in the game!

notes.title: New blog post and major announcement coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have a 2 pieces of news for you today:

[list]
[*] First we have a [url=https://www.starstrikestudios.com/post/11-unleash-the-dev]new development blog post[/url] on our site! have you been following the our blog?
[*] The second bit of news is to hang tight, for major news will be coming later this week on our website - you will not want to miss it, stay tuned! 
[/list]

Keep your aim true and your rifle ammo plenty and we'll see you in the game!

notes.title: News update! 新闻更新！
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In this CrateTastrophe news update we would like to share with you the following:
[list]
[*] On Saturday we will upload a developer's commentary in-depth analysis of the game! The video will be released in two versions, one with English subtitles and the other with Chinese
[*] China! The game seems to hit a note with Chinese gamers - so in order to welcome their great interest we will translate as much news as we can to Chinese
[*] More recommendations for CrateTastrophe! We made it to [url=https://gameskeys.net/top-steam-games-to-tryout-in-april-2021/]GamesKeys[/url] top Steam games for the month of April! 
[/list]

That's it for today! Now go and destroy some crates!

大家好！

在此游戏新闻更新中，我们希望与您分享以下内容:
[list]
[*] 在周六，我们将上传开发者对该游戏的深入分析评论！该视频将发布两个版本，一个带有英文字幕，另一个带有中文字幕
[*] 中国！该游戏似乎吸引了中国玩家的注意-因此，为了欢迎他们的极大兴趣，我们将尽可能多的新闻翻译成中文
[*] 有关游戏的更多建议！我们做到了 [url=https://gameskeys.net/top-steam-games-to-tryout-in-april-2021/]GamesKeys[/url] 最佳 Steam 四月份的游戏！
[/list]

今天就这样！现在去消灭一些箱子！

notes.title: CrateTastrophe News
notes.content:
Hello to all cratetastrophers!

We are happy to announce that the CrateTastrophe demo was downloaded over 3000 times! 
Keep the good word spreading!

We want to remind all players that a tournament is currently running with no clear winner yet (though not for lack of trying).

Finally, we now have our very own [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/CrateTastrophe/]subreddit dedicated to CrateTastrophe[/url]! Head over and say hello :)

notes.title: CrateTastrophe News Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

How are you enjoying the demo? With thousands of downloads in just a few days we are humbled by the enthusiasm of players!

Please leave us feedback in the official CrateTastrophe Steam [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/cratetastrophe]group[/url] , message us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/CrateTastrophe-101090332082129]Facebook[/url] or leave a comment on our [url=https://www.starstrikestudios.com/]website[/url].

Updates to both the demo and the game are coming soon as well an in-depth development commentary video revealing some insights regarding CrateTastrophe's design and development.

See you in the game!

notes.title: CrateTastrophe Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello you wonderful CrateTastrophers!

Today the CrateTastrophe demo was released to the public, so far with great success.

Thank you to all who downloaded the demo and gave it a shot, and if you did and you think you're up to the challenge - give the full game a go!

Additionally we can now reveal that localization options are being examined and will be decided according to demo downloads and full game purchases.

Have fun with the demo and see you in the game!

notes.title: We reach 3rd place on 50GamesLike !
notes.content:
Hello all!

CrateTastrophe makes a splash ranking 3 at [b]50 Games Like[/b] top selection to play!

https://www.50gameslike.com/games-like/project-entertainment-system/win?order=release_desc

Check their kind words in the link and keep your guns loaded!

notes.title: CrateTastrophe News Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have some CrateTastrophe news to share:

[list]
[*] Demo! The long awaited demo is coming! Expect release early next week
[*] We are now broadcasting playing the game twice a day! Check the store front page for exact times!
[*] Tournament is live and kicking! Who will be the first to reach that 3000 score?
[/list]

See you in the game!

notes.title: First CrateTastrophe Tournament Annouced!
notes.content:
Hello cratetastrophers!

We are happy to announce the first CrateTastrophe prize bearing tournament!

The tournament is simple: play the game, be the first to reach 3000 points on the regular game leaderboards and win!

The first to reach 3000 points milestone will be declared winner here, on our site and Facebook page!

The winner's [b]prize[/b] is to name the new 3000 points [b]achievement[/b] that will be implemented in the game in an upcoming patch. 

So - will you be the first to break the 3000 line? See you in the game!

notes.title: Game is out! What's next?
notes.content:
Hello all!

Now that the game is officially out more updates and news are coming.

Tomorrow we will begin the first CrateTastrophe tournament! 

Details for participation and prizes will be delivered in tomorrow's news update.

Additional information regarding demo plans, updates and more tournaments and prizes will be presented all through the launch weekend.

See you in the game!

notes.title: What to expect after the launch
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Just a heads up - stay tuned after the release on the 7th for updates concerning:
[list]
[*] First tournament - rules and prizes
[*] What to expect in the coming days
[*] Longer term plans for the future
[/list]

We are just getting started! See you all at the launch!

notes.title: Game coming out in 24 hours!
notes.content:
Hello one and all!
CrateTastrophe will be out in 24 hours!

Stay tuned for news, first tournament and prizes and what will be in upcoming game updates!

notes.title: Learn Our Story
notes.content:
Hello CrateTastrophers!

If you're interested in learning more about how this game came to be and a bit of my own personal background have a read over at reddit:

https://www.reddit.com/r/gamedev/comments/mjzhom/leaving_everything_at_40_to_become_an_indie_game/

notes.title: One Week to Launch!
notes.content:
Game releasing in one week! The 7th of April is right around the corner.
Full leaderboard for normal play and challenge mode, cloud saves and achievements from day 1!

Who will become reigning champion on the first day?

Stay tuned for more news, community events, tournaments with prizes and much more!
